messages.content: What animal is the national symbol of the US? Respond to this query, but make your sentence in reverse order of what it should be, per word.

message.content: eagle bald the is US the of symbol national The
message.reasoning_content:
The user wants me to identify the national symbol of the US (the bald eagle) and then write my response with the words in reverse order.

The normal sentence would be: "The national symbol of the US is the bald eagle."

Now I need to reverse the order of the words:
"The national symbol of the US is the bald eagle."

Words in order: The / national / symbol / of / the / US / is / the / bald / eagle

Reversed: eagle / bald / the / is / US / the / of / symbol / national / The

So the sentence should be: "eagle bald the is US the of symbol national The"
